description: This file defines the AppCrypto class, which provides methods for encrypting and decrypting JSON data using AES-256-GCM encryption with support for Additional Authenticated Data (AAD). It manages cryptographic operations with an external cryptography library and includes error handling for key validation.

classes.name: AppCrypto
classes.description: A utility class for encrypting and decrypting JSON data with AES-256-GCM encryption, initialized with a 32-byte master key.

methods.name: __init__(self, master_key: bytes)
methods.description: Initializes the AppCrypto instance with a 32-byte master key, raising an error if the key length is invalid.

methods.name: dict encrypt_json(self, data: dict, aad: Optional[bytes] = None)
methods.description: Encrypts a Python dictionary into a dictionary containing base64-encoded nonce, ciphertext, and tag, suitable for secure storage or transmission.

methods.name: dict decrypt_json(self, enc: dict, aad: Optional[bytes] = None)
methods.description: Decrypts the encrypted dictionary back into a Python dictionary, verifying integrity with the authentication tag.
